This topic is part of the AQA A-Level Environmental Science specification.

The Physical Environment appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Physical Environment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
